Operations.Name: GetEpisodes
Operations.Description: Gets episodes for a tv season.

Options.Name: userId
Options.Description: The user id.

Options.Name: fields
Options.Description: Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines, TrailerUrls.

Options.Name: season
Options.Description: Optional filter by season number.

Options.Name: seasonId
Options.Description: Optional. Filter by season id.

Options.Name: isMissing
Options.Description: Optional. Filter by items that are missing episodes or not.

Options.Name: adjacentTo
Options.Description: Optional. Return items that are siblings of a supplied item.

Options.Name: startItemId
Options.Description: Optional. Skip through the list until a given item is found.

Options.Name: startIndex
Options.Description: Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.

Options.Name: limit
Options.Description: Optional. The maximum number of records to return.

Options.Name: enableImages
Options.Description: Optional, include image information in output.

Options.Name: imageTypeLimit
Options.Description: Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.

Options.Name: enableImageTypes
Options.Description: Optional. The image types to include in the output.

Options.Name: enableUserData
Options.Description: Optional. Include user data.

Options.Name: sortBy
Options.Description: Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Album, AlbumArtist, Artist, Budget, CommunityRating, CriticRating, DateCreated, DatePlayed, PlayCount, PremiereDate, ProductionYear, SortName, Random, Revenue, Runtime.

Operations.Name: GetNextUp
Operations.Description: Gets a list of next up episodes.

Options.Name: userId
Options.Description: The user id of the user to get the next up episodes for.

Options.Name: startIndex
Options.Description: Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.

Options.Name: limit
Options.Description: Optional. The maximum number of records to return.

Options.Name: fields
Options.Description: Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.

Options.Name: seriesId
Options.Description: Optional. Filter by series id.

Options.Name: parentId
Options.Description: Optional. Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.

Options.Name: enableImages
Options.Description: Optional. Include image information in output.

Options.Name: imageTypeLimit
Options.Description: Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.

Options.Name: enableImageTypes
Options.Description: Optional. The image types to include in the output.

Options.Name: enableUserData
Options.Description: Optional. Include user data.

Options.Name: nextUpDateCutoff
Options.Description: Optional. Starting date of shows to show in Next Up section.

Options.Name: enableTotalRecordCount
Options.Description: Whether to enable the total records count. Defaults to true.

Options.Name: enableResumable
Options.Description: Whether to include resumable episodes in next up results.

Options.Name: enableRewatching
Options.Description: Whether to include watched episodes in next up results.
